episodes.title: Parte 1
episodes.summary: While Nadia gets accustomed to life in New York, an opportunity to visit Madrid arises and she struggles with whether or not to tell Guzmán.

episodes.title: Parte 2
episodes.summary: Nadia and Guzmán come to an agreement about seeing each other. Meanwhile, newlywed May gives her little sister advice on love.

episodes.title: Parte 3
episodes.summary: In an attempt to manage her emotions, Nadia demands Guzmán follow very specific rules for their reunion date.
